pages.text: Linked, you walk your body and see through the Collar Cam. The bar shows LINK %%, delay, which end you are and the distance.$(br2)Signal is full to half the goggles' range, 0 at the range. Your head in the Head Satchel gives 100%%.

Water, deep rock, thunder, portals and Darkness weaken it. Under 20%%, clicks get lost; 5 s at 0%% and you wake in your head.$(br2)The swap key, $(k:key.headinajar.swap), takes your body to head always, but head to body only over 20%%.
